name: Faroe Islands
prevalence_note: On 2026-08-06 Føroya Politi, Talgildu Føroyar and the Faroese banks issued a joint warning: since February that year, more islanders have been receiving bogus text messages with a link that asks them to hand over personal details, often as if the sender were a bank, Posta, Nets, Samleikin or another official body. The notice says some people have already given information and that a few cases have led to money loss, but it also says there is still no full count of cases or losses.
cross_border_note: The Faroe Islands have their own police district and the public calling code +298. The joint notice stresses that a familiar name or a familiar-looking telephone number in the message can still be forged, so a display that resembles a bank or a Danish service mark is not proof that the sender is in Tórshavn.

scams.name: Falske sms-beskeder med link, der udgiver sig for at være pengeinstitut, Posta, Nets eller Samleikin
scams.name_en: Føroya Politi joint warning: fake text messages with a link, spoofing a bank, Posta, Nets, Samleikin or another authority, seeking personal details
scams.signals_en: An unexpected text with a familiar name or local-looking number urges the recipient to click a link, update details or pay a fee. Officials warn organised criminals use haste to steal personal numbers, card data, emails and passwords.
scams.legit_en: Banks, insurers, Posta, Samleikin and authorities never ask for secret or personal data via text. Real checks start when the customer contacts the institution directly—not via an SMS link—or blocks a card in netbank.
bait_tactics: Læg røret på og ring selv til pengeinstituttet eller den myndighed, der siges at være afsender, via en kontaktvej du allerede kender, ikke via linket i sms'en.
Sig at hemmelige oplysninger eller kort data aldrig afgives i en uventet sms, uanset hvilket navn der står som afsender.
Spørg hvilken konkret tjeneste eller hvilken afdeling beskeden skulle komme fra, og tilbyd at tage sagen gennem netbanken eller den officielle indgang i stedet.
